title: Devon police renewed shotgun licence of known abuser who later killed his wife
summary_full: Ex-marine John Perkins, who also killed himself, had been violent to Kathryn Perkins over 42-year marriage, Exeter inquests hearA “controlling and violent” former Royal Marine who shot his wife dead after she told him she was leaving was allowed to keep two licensed shotguns despite police knowing he had a history of domestic abuse.John Perkins shot Kathryn Perkins at their home in Devon with a double-barrelled shotgun before killing himself with his second weapon.
